articles.summary: Each month, Cyabra's experts share the articles, reports, and investigations shaping the conversation around misinformation, narrative intelligence and deepfakes. This September, from AI chatbots buckling under sustained misinformation pressure to the growing legal fight against deepfake harm, one thing is clear: as generative AI reshapes how false narratives are created and corrected, distinguishing reliable information from AI-amplified falsehoods is more critical than ever.
articles.title: Misinformation Monthly – September

articles.summary: Cyabra analyzed the #PSBlackout boycott surrounding Sony's decision to phase out physical discs. The anger was real. The amplification wasn't entirely organic.
articles.title: The PlayStation Boycott Was Real. The Network Behind It Wasn’t.
